slides.title: Investify
body: F26-003-Investify
FYP-1 mid-evaluation working draft
Educational equity decisions with recorded evidence and checked explanations
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the team and supervisor. The preparation date is 13 October 2026, not a confirmed assessment date. Present the actual implementation and disclose the historical model limitation.

slides.title: The problem
body: A Buy/Hold/Sell label leaves the evidence and uncertainty unexplained.
An explanation can sound plausible while contradicting its recorded values.
An evaluation can overstate performance when information is aligned after its availability time.
slides.speaker_notes: Explain the retail-user interpretation task. Investify is educational and does not execute orders. Its numerical consistency checks and temporal controls must be evaluated independently of predictive usefulness.

slides.title: Implemented scope
body: Historical NVDA decisions from two news experiments

slides.speaker_notes: The full proposal remains broader. The separate blend fits 148 earlier feature rows and scores 38 later sessions per corpus. Its profile weighting is unvalidated for suitability/performance. Social sentiment, raw inputs and scientific reproduction remain pending. A separate fresh Alpaca input-to-model experiment now completes all six leakage arms and both calibration modes; September inputs and the exact lock are not reproduced.

slides.title: The explanation path
body: A validated decision record supplies probabilities, feature values and attributions.
The context builder supplies all feature meanings and coverage limits.
The verifier checks visible sentences and JSON independently.
Rejected or unavailable generation selects a verified deterministic explanation.
slides.speaker_notes: Use the report architecture source when the slide renderer is available. The local LLM adapter has bounded retries and records failed attempts. Distinguish ready integration code from an actually evaluated model.

slides.title: Fresh experiment: calibration limitation
body: Actual retained-model, calibration and native-TreeSHAP replay passes.
Lower Brier does not resolve all-Buy classifications or establish useful prediction.
slides.speaker_notes: These are new real Alpaca revision-conservative results, not overwritten September metrics. 181 calibration rows remain after excluding five unavailable labels; evaluation has 186 sessions from 29 March to 21 December 2023. Frozen raw predictions vary, but fitted isotonic maps make Buy largest on every evaluation row. Refitting is not required for this fresh collapse. The preserved historical cause is still unproven. Do not tune thresholds on this evaluation fold to manufacture varied decisions.

slides.title: Original sentiment comparison
body: Both original candidates complete the same 24 frozen MSFT posts.
CryptoBERT predicts only neutral. Cardiff leads this exploratory benchmark.
AI-reference agreement, with only two negative examples. Final deployment selection remains open.
slides.speaker_notes: 117 usable AI references come from 200 real posts, with 83 exclusions and a frozen 93/24 split. The labels are not independently human validated; one held-out prediction changes agreement by 4.17 points and negative recall by 50 points. Original publisher bytes are verified. Lossless Cardiff serialization preserves all keys, dtypes, shapes and raw bytes; its native unused pooler has exact logit parity. No predeclared adequacy threshold exists, so the deployment choice stays unset. These results do not establish NVDA transfer or return prediction.
